fullAnalysis: Puzzle #677 points to "Types of dresses" because every clue completes a dress phrase people already know.

Sundress, wrap dress, cocktail dress, wedding dress, and little black dress all fit naturally. Once you spot two or three, the rest of the board becomes a clean clothing category instead of a vague event theme.

lessons.title: Event clues can point to objects, not occasions
lessons.body: Cocktail and wedding feel like events, but they complete dress phrases instead. If multiple clues sound like settings, test whether they all point to the same type of object.

lessons.title: Fashion phrases use everyday two-word compounds
lessons.body: Style categories like wrap dress and little black dress are fixed phrases in everyday language. Pinpoint favors these well-known compounds because they leave no ambiguity once you test the right suffix.

lessons.title: Three confirming clues are enough to commit
lessons.body: Sun, wrap, and wedding all complete dress cleanly. Once three clues verify a pattern, apply it to the remaining two rather than second-guessing the category.
